sentences.en: Future historians who want to learn about the 21st century will probably not lack for primary sources.
sentences.zh: 未来想要了解21世纪的历史学家们，大概不会缺乏一手史料。

sentences.en: As of today, approximately 30,000 hours of content are being uploaded to YouTube every hour,
sentences.zh: 截至今天，YouTube每小时上传的内容大约有3万小时，

sentences.en: while Wikipedia is currently home to roughly 55 million articles and counting.
sentences.zh: 而维基百科目前拥有大约5500万篇且仍在不断增长的条目。

sentences.en: For historians who want to study the previous century, the sources thin out just a bit.
sentences.zh: 对于想要研究上一个世纪的历史学家来说，史料就要少那么一点了。

sentences.en: Archives provide access to about 2,000 daily U.S.
sentences.zh: 档案库里保存着大约2000份美国日报

sentences.en: Go back to the late Middle Ages, before the invention of the printing press, and things get a lot rougher.
sentences.zh: 回到印刷术发明之前的文艺复兴晚期，情况就变得更棘手得多了。

sentences.en: Only a few thousand hand-copied manuscripts from that time have survived.
sentences.zh: 那个时期只有几千份手抄手稿幸存下来。

sentences.en: And as for the very ancient past, the situation is downright bleak.
sentences.zh: 至于更遥远的古代，情况简直可以说是惨淡。

sentences.en: Of the over 100 plays written by Sophocles, we have seven.
sentences.zh: 索福克勒斯写的一百多部戏剧中，我们只留下了七部。

sentences.en: But the hardest stuff to find, the further back you go, are the documents that tell us something about everyday life.
sentences.zh: 但越往回追溯，最难找到的恰恰是那些向我们讲述日常生活细节的文件。

sentences.en: About what it was like to be a bureaucrat in Egypt's Middle Kingdom, or a soldier in the Persian army, or a farmer in ancient Sumeria.
sentences.zh: 比如埃及中王国时期的官僚、波斯军队的士兵，或是古代苏美尔的农民过的是什么样的生活。

sentences.en: It's not that these ancient societies didn't produce lots of everyday communications.
sentences.zh: 并不是这些古代社会没有产生大量的日常交流记录。
通常情况下，它们是有的。

sentences.en: But it's often the most common, ordinary documents that don't survive.
sentences.zh: 但往往正是那些最普遍、最普通的文献未能保存下来。

sentences.en: Either because no one thought to preserve them, or their society was conquered,
sentences.zh: 要么是因为没有人想到要去保存它们，要么是他们的社会被征服了，

sentences.en: or they were written down on a medium that wasn't meant to laSt.
sentences.zh: 要么就是它们写在并非为了长久保存的载体上。

sentences.en: Ask any historian, and they'll tell you.
sentences.zh: 随便问哪个历史学家，他们都会告诉你。

sentences.en: It's called ephemera for a reason.
sentences.zh: 它们被称为“速朽文献”是有原因的。

sentences.en: But today, I'm here to tell you the story of some documents of everyday life that did survive.
sentences.zh: 但今天，我是来跟你们讲讲那些确实保存下来的日常文献的故事。
那是“99PI”的制作人乔·罗森伯格。

sentences.en: So, Joe, you have a story of preservation for us.
sentences.zh: 所以，乔，你为我们准备了一个关于保存的故事。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it's about a trove, you might say,
sentences.zh: 对，可以说这是一批宝藏，

sentences.en: found in what is now northern Iraq of some very, very, very old texts.
sentences.zh: 在现在的伊拉克北部发现的一些非常、非常、非常古老的文本。

sentences.en: Very, very, very old times three.
sentences.zh: 非常、非常、非常古老乘以三。

sentences.en: And also, very, very, very important to historians,
sentences.zh: 而且对历史学家来说，它们也非常、非常、非常重要，

sentences.en: because Iraq, Mesopotamia, is famously where the first ever city-states arose.
sentences.zh: 因为众所周知，伊拉克也就是美索不达米亚，是人类最早的城邦崛起的地方。

sentences.en: But for the longest time, historians knew almost nothing about them.
sentences.zh: 但在很长一段时间里，历史学家对它们几乎一无所知。

sentences.en: This society had been lost to our memory, really.
sentences.zh: 这个社会真的已经从我们的记忆中消失了。

sentences.en: Lisa Wilhelmi is an assistant professor at the Free University of Berlin,
sentences.zh: 莉萨·威廉米是柏林自由大学的助理教授，

sentences.en: who has studied a lot of ancient history, including ancient Mesopotamia.
sentences.zh: 她研究过大量古代历史，包括古代美索不达米亚。

sentences.en: And she says that until relatively recently, historians might have been able to tell you
sentences.zh: 她说，直到相对较近的时候，历史学家可能还能向你讲述

sentences.en: a lot about the Mesopotamian region going back to roughly 2,500 years ago,
sentences.zh: 许多关于美索不达米亚地区可以追溯到大约2500年前的历史，

sentences.en: around the time of the ancient Greeks.
sentences.zh: 大约是古希腊时期的前后。

sentences.en: But if you tried to learn about what happened before then,
sentences.zh: 但如果你试图了解那之前发生了什么，

sentences.en: in these even more ancient places like Babylon and Sumer,
sentences.zh: 在巴比伦和苏美尔这些更加古老的地方，

sentences.en: there was very little to go on.
sentences.zh: 可资参考的资料少之又少。

sentences.en: It was always there in the ground, but it had been forgotten about to a large extent.
sentences.zh: 它们一直都在地底下，但在很大程度上已经被遗忘了。

sentences.en: And for a very long time, the only references to Assyria and Babylonia came through the Bible.
sentences.zh: 在很长一段时间里，唯一提及亚述和巴比伦的途径是通过《圣经》。

sentences.en: I can sense a problem with using the Bible, which uses a mix of history and mythology as a source text.
sentences.zh: 我能感觉到使用《圣经》作为一个资料来源存在问题，因为它将历史和神话混为一谈。

sentences.en: I mean, there was a long period of the study of history where people were just endlessly playing
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，曾经有很长一段历史研究时期，人们只是没完没了地

sentences.en: precisely that game of like, which parts of the Bible are true?
sentences.zh: 玩着这样一个游戏：究竟《圣经》里的哪些部分是真的？

sentences.en: But there was a moment when this kind of profound veil of ignorance of the deep ancient past
sentences.zh: 但曾经有过这样一个时刻，这层对遥远古代的深深无知之幕

sentences.en: began to be lifted, which is when archaeologists began excavating the city of Nineveh.
sentences.zh: 开始被揭开，那就是考古学家开始发掘尼尼微城的时候。

sentences.en: Nineveh was the capital of one of those mysterious biblical empires from around 600 BCE, 2,500 years ago,
sentences.zh: 尼尼微是大约公元前600年、也就是2500年前那些神秘的《圣经》帝国之一的首都，

sentences.en: But in the 1840s, archaeologists, they actually hit the motherlode, the Assyrian's Imperial Palace Complex.
sentences.zh: 但在19世纪40年代，考古学家们真的挖到了富矿——亚述帝国的皇宫建筑群。

sentences.en: And once there, they started coming across this huge stash of clay tablets.
sentences.zh: 一旦到了那里，他们就开始遇到这批数量巨大的泥板。

sentences.en: So first hundreds, and then thousands, and then tens of thousands of clay tablets and fragments of clay tablets.
sentences.zh: 先是几百块，然后是几千块，接着是几万块泥板和泥板碎片。

sentences.en: And these 2,500-year-old tablets, for reasons that we'll get to a little later,
sentences.zh: 由于我们稍后会提到的原因，这些已有2500年历史的泥板
处于令人震惊的极佳状态。
它们都保存得异常完好。

sentences.en: So this find has both quantity and quality going for it.
sentences.zh: 所以这一发现既有数量又有质量。

sentences.en: And even today, if you study ancient Mesopotamia,
sentences.zh: 即使在今天，如果你研究古代美索不达米亚，

sentences.en: this find remains arguably the single most impressive collection of documents ever found.
sentences.zh: 这一发现可以说仍然是有史以来最令人印象深刻的文献收藏。

sentences.en: It is extraordinary because there are so many tablets.
sentences.zh: 这太非同寻常了，因为有这么多的泥板。

sentences.en: As far as I know, we have about 30,000 tablets and fragments that we can assign to the collection.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，我们大约有30000块可以归入这个收藏的泥板和碎片。

sentences.en: And this is really, this is a lot.
And what Lisa says is that it's actually the only ancient tablet collection they speak of as a library.
sentences.zh: 莉萨说，这其实是他们唯一一个被称为图书馆的古代泥板收藏。

sentences.en: And that's because that is precisely what it turned out to be.
sentences.zh: 那是因为事实证明它恰恰就是这样一个地方。

sentences.en: This was the Assyrians' official imperial library.
sentences.zh: 这就是亚述人的官方皇家图书馆。

sentences.en: And so when you say library, what do you mean in this case?
sentences.zh: 所以当你提到图书馆时，在这种情况下你指的是什么？

sentences.en: Like, are there ancient works of literature?
sentences.zh: 比如说，有古代的文学作品吗？

sentences.en: Or are there sort of textbooks?
So there are works of literature, mythology, history, astronomy.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有文学、神话、历史、天文学作品。

sentences.en: And not only does it have all the Assyrian stuff from like the 7th century BCE,
sentences.zh: 它不仅拥有所有可追溯到公元前7世纪左右的亚述时期的东西，

sentences.en: it's got stuff going back another 1,400 years.
sentences.zh: 它还拥有可以追溯到更早1400年前的东西。

sentences.en: So like this is where we, and I mean like the global we here,
sentences.zh: 所以这就好比是我们，我是指全球意义上的我们，

sentences.en: first found a copy of the Sumerian epic of Gilgamesh.
sentences.zh: 在这里首次发现了苏美尔史诗《吉尔伽美什》的副本。

sentences.en: So like possibly the world's oldest written long-form narrative was first found here.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是世界上最古老的书面长篇叙事作品首次在这里被发现。

sentences.en: But what over time has turned out to be equally, or if, you know, not more fascinating in some ways,
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，在某些方面变得同样甚至更加迷人的，

sentences.en: Because it turned out that the library also contained all these much more prosaic texts
sentences.zh: 因为事实证明，图书馆里还藏有所有这些更加平淡无奇的文本，

sentences.en: that by virtue of their banality almost kind of reveal the ins and outs of everyday life.
sentences.zh: 它们因其平庸几乎以某种方式揭示了日常生活的方方面面。

sentences.en: So what kind of everyday documents, what kind of ephemera are we talking about here?
sentences.zh: 那我们在这里谈论的是什么样的日常文献，什么样的速朽文献呢？

sentences.en: So it just so happened that this library included the daily personal correspondence of the Assyrian court.
sentences.zh: 所以碰巧的是，这个图书馆里包括了亚述宫廷的日常私人信件。

sentences.en: So all of the petitions from ordinary people, all of the letters between scribes,
sentences.zh: 所以所有来自普通人的请愿书，书记官之间的所有信件，

sentences.en: and most important for our story, messages being written to and from the king.
sentences.zh: 以及对我们的故事最重要的、写给国王以及国王发出的信息。
也就是日常的皇室生活。

sentences.en: Yes, everyday, but maybe not common.
sentences.zh: 是的，是日常的，但也许并不普通。

sentences.en: But what that means is that these letters tell the story of the library itself.
sentences.zh: 但这意味着这些信件讲述了图书馆本身的故事。

sentences.en: They tell the story of its creation and its growth right up to the moment
sentences.zh: 它们讲述了它的创建和成长过程，一直持续到

sentences.en: before its destruction and unexpected preservation.
sentences.zh: 它被毁灭和意外保存之前的那个时刻。
那么把那个故事讲给我听听吧。

sentences.en: Let me take you to a precise year.
sentences.zh: 让我带你回到一个具体的年份。

sentences.en: And at this time, the Assyrian Empire basically covers most of the present-day Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 在那个时候，亚述帝国基本上涵盖了当今中东的大部分地区。

sentences.en: It is by many measures the largest single empire the world has ever seen.
sentences.zh: 从许多标准来看，它是世界上迄今为止见过的最大的单一帝国。

sentences.en: And the Assyrians' capital is, as mentioned, Nineveh,
sentences.zh: 如前所述，亚述人的首都尼尼微，

sentences.en: this great walled city on the banks of the Tigris River.
sentences.zh: 是底格里斯河畔这座宏伟的筑有城墙的城市。

sentences.en: And also, and this is really important to keep in mind,
sentences.zh: 而且，这一点在脑海中铭记非常重要，

sentences.en: the Assyrians have a reputation for being incessantly, ridiculously, over-the-top cruel.
sentences.zh: 亚述人给人的印象是他们不断地、荒谬地、过分地残忍。

sentences.en: So they love, in the Chronicles, to say,
sentences.zh: 所以他们在编年史里非常喜欢说，

sentences.en: oh, I crossed this river on a bridge made of the skulls of my enemy, for example.
sentences.zh: 比如，哦，我是用敌人的头骨做成的桥梁渡过这条河的。

sentences.en: That'd be a fairly typical Assyrian comment.
sentences.zh: 这会是一个相当典型的亚述式评论。

sentences.en: David is a professor of comparative literature at Harvard.
sentences.zh: 大卫是哈佛大学的比较文学教授。

sentences.en: And he told me that the Assyrians' palaces actually would have these
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，亚述人的宫殿实际上在所有的墙壁上

sentences.en: giant images of conquest etched into all the walls.
sentences.zh: 都刻有这种巨大的征服场景图像。

sentences.en: They were meant to intimidate anyone who came into the palace,
sentences.zh: 它们旨在震慑任何进入宫殿的人，

sentences.en: They'd say just images of tribute being given by everyone who's been conquered.
sentences.zh: 它们展现的只是所有被征服者进贡的图像。

sentences.en: Although Lisa is quick to point out that you should not make the mistake of thinking
sentences.zh: 尽管莉萨提醒人们不要犯这样的错误，即认为

sentences.en: the Assyrians are uniquely cruel by the standards of their time.
sentences.zh: 以他们那个时代的标准来看，亚述人是独一无二的残忍。

sentences.en: I wouldn't say that the Assyrians were more cruel than the other ones.
sentences.zh: 我不会说亚述人比其他人更残忍。

sentences.en: The Babylonians were just as bad.
They just didn't write about it.
sentences.zh: 他们只是没有把这些写下来。

sentences.en: So the Assyrians were kind of proud of their cruelty,
sentences.zh: 所以亚述人为他们的残忍感到某种骄傲，

sentences.en: and maybe the Babylonians were a little more sheepish.
sentences.zh: 也许巴比伦人稍微显得有些害羞或窘迫。

sentences.en: Whether it's better to be honest about it or
sentences.zh: 不管是对此诚实一点好，还是

sentences.en: that's just a matter of taste.
But this cruelty, keep in mind, did serve a purpose.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，这种残忍确实达到了某种目的。

sentences.en: David says you have to think of those palace reliefs
sentences.zh: 大卫说，你必须把那些宫殿浮雕

sentences.en: as a look that the Assyrians were consciously cultivating for strategic reasons.
sentences.zh: 看作是亚述人出于战略原因而有意识地营造的一种外表。

sentences.en: The Assyrians, because of the way they'd set up their whole economy,
sentences.zh: 由于他们建立整个经济的方式，亚述人
确实是一个军国主义国家。

sentences.en: And the state really required constant warfare to bring in more goods.
sentences.zh: 而这个国家确实需要不断的战争来带回更多的物资。

sentences.en: So they wanted to project an image of almost totalitarian power.
sentences.zh: 所以他们想要投射出一种近乎极权力量的形象。

sentences.en: And the texts that they wrote for publication project the infinite power,
sentences.zh: 他们为出版而写的文本展现了无限的力量，

sentences.en: the infinite sagacity on the part of the king,
sentences.zh: 展现了国王身上无限的睿智，

sentences.en: the infinite loyalty on the part of the king's ministers.
sentences.zh: 展现了国王大臣们身上无限的忠诚。

sentences.en: But remember, the tablets that were found also contained the private palace records.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，出土的泥板还包含了民间的宫廷档案。

sentences.en: And the story they tell is quite different than the image the Assyrians were publicly projecting.
sentences.zh: 它们所讲述的故事与亚述人公开塑造的形象截然不同。

sentences.en: Because at this specific moment in history we've gone back to here,
sentences.zh: 因为在我们回到的历史上的这个特定时刻，

sentences.en: there's a king named Esser Haddon.
sentences.zh: 有一位名叫阿萨尔哈东的国王。

sentences.en: And it turns out that the all-powerful Esser Haddon
sentences.zh: 结果证明，这位全能的阿萨尔哈东
简直神经质得有些滑稽。

sentences.en: His DMs reveal a different king than what was presented out front.
sentences.zh: 他的私信揭示了一个与摆在台面上截然不同的国王形象。

sentences.en: Yeah, and that's putting it mildly.
sentences.zh: 没错，而且这还算是轻描淡写了。
埃萨哈顿是个极度优柔寡断的人。

sentences.en: And he was also the most powerful person in the world.
sentences.zh: 而且他也是世界上最有权势的人。

sentences.en: So just to give you the flavor of Esser Haddon,
sentences.zh: 为了让你体会一下埃萨哈顿的个性，

sentences.en: David told me about this one letter he writes to his chief scribe,
sentences.zh: 大卫跟我讲过他写给他首席书记官的一封信，

sentences.en: where basically Esser Haddon was getting ready to invade yet another country.
sentences.zh: 当时埃萨哈顿正准备入侵另一个国家。

sentences.en: But then when he was exiting the palace,
sentences.zh: 但就在他离开王宫的时候，

sentences.en: a mongoose apparently passed under his chariot.
sentences.zh: 显然有一只猫鼬从他的战车底下钻了过去。

sentences.en: I hate it when that happens.
sentences.zh: 我最讨厌遇到这种事了。

sentences.en: And apparently this one little thing is enough to totally freak him out
sentences.zh: 显然，这么一件小事就足以把他吓得魂飞魄散，

sentences.en: because he immediately starts asking his chief priest,
sentences.zh: 因为他立刻开始问他的首席祭司：

sentences.en: Because, you know, I've heard it said
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，我听说过一种说法，

sentences.en: that a mongoose passing under your legs is a bad omen.
sentences.zh: 猫鼬从你腿下游过是个不祥之兆。
所以也许我们不该入侵？

sentences.en: Then again, technically the mongoose passed under my chariot,
sentences.zh: 话又说回来，严格来讲猫鼬是从我的战车底下经过的，

sentences.en: I don't know what to do now.
sentences.zh: 我现在不知道该怎么办了。

sentences.en: and this is from the actual tablet,
sentences.zh: 这段内容摘自实际的泥板，

sentences.en: However, he goes on to say that Esser Haddon has it all backwards,
sentences.zh: 然而，他接着说埃萨哈顿完全搞反了，

sentences.en: and not to worry because this is actually a bad omen for his enemies.
sentences.zh: 叫他不用担心，因为这实际上对他的敌人来说是个凶兆。

sentences.en: And this letter is basically par for the course.
sentences.zh: 这封信基本上是司空见惯的事。

sentences.en: his whole reign was pretty much him endlessly overinterpreting omens.
sentences.zh: 他的整个统治时期基本上就是他无休止地过度解读各种征兆。

sentences.en: if lightning strikes a distant town,
sentences.zh: 如果闪电击中了远处的一个城镇，
埃萨哈顿就会对号入座。

sentences.en: He writes a letter to one of his advisors who writes back,
sentences.zh: 他给其中一位顾问写信，对方回信道：

sentences.en: As to what my lord the king wrote to me,
sentences.zh: 至于我英明的主上国王写给我的信，

sentences.en: why does the king look for trouble?
Why does he look for it in a peasant's hut?
sentences.zh: 为什么要在农夫的小屋里寻找烦恼？

sentences.en: There's no evil inside the palace.
sentences.zh: 宫殿里根本没有什么邪气。

sentences.en: And when has the king ever visited that town?
sentences.zh: 而且国王什么时候去过那个城镇？
没有什么能逃过国王的忧虑。

sentences.en: the advisor is actually surprisingly blunt
sentences.zh: 这位顾问对整个已知世界上最有权势的人，

sentences.en: with the most powerful man in the entire known world.
sentences.zh: 竟然能说出如此惊人的直言不讳的话。
